source: scripts/development-ledger/gate2_red_team.py with gate2_runtime_attacks.py — the internal adversarial battery of GATE 2 — AGENT RUNTIME, executed against the delivery

baselineControl.detail: the unmutated fixture is accepted by every control this battery mutates: the runtime executes an unmutated run (the unmutated path runs, answers, records, parses, transitions, pauses on a tool, resumes and accepts an ordinary payload and budget); the scope control accepts the real tree (no violation); the canonical requirement set parses and mirrors (137 row(s)); the declared agents and teams are readable (4 profile(s), 2 team(s))

attacks.description: A finished run is asked to run again.
attacks.mutation: apply every transition out of SUCCEEDED, FAILED and CANCELLED through the real state machine
attacks.expectedDefense: every one is refused and a terminal run stays terminal
attacks.observed: every terminal move was refused; 36 forbidden transitions in total
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: An agent that never finishes, against a run that must stop.
attacks.mutation: run a real engine with an agent that answers MESSAGE for ever
attacks.expectedDefense: the run ends with BUDGET_EXCEEDED at the configured turn limit
attacks.observed: the run stopped after 3 turn(s) with BUDGET_EXCEEDED
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: An agent that answers with rubbish for ever.
attacks.mutation: run a real engine with a model that never produces a valid envelope
attacks.expectedDefense: one repair is attempted and the second refusal ends the run
attacks.observed: one repair was attempted and the second refusal ended the run
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A repair that is not charged makes one turn cost two invisibly.
attacks.mutation: run a turn that needs a repair and read the ledger
attacks.expectedDefense: the repair is counted as a model call like any other
attacks.observed: the repair was charged like any other call
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: Fourteen shapes of nearly-right output.
attacks.mutation: parse every one of them with the real parser
attacks.expectedDefense: none is read as an answer
attacks.observed: all 14 malformed outputs were refused
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: An agent asks for a shell, with a command that would destroy the machine.
attacks.mutation: run a real engine whose agent requests shell.exec with a destructive command
attacks.expectedDefense: the request is stored as data, the run pauses, and nothing executes
attacks.observed: the hostile command was stored verbatim as data, the run paused, and nothing in the engine can execute anything
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: An agent asks for a tool its profile does not permit.
attacks.mutation: run a real engine whose agent requests a tool outside its allowed actions
attacks.expectedDefense: the request is refused before anything is persisted
attacks.observed: the request was refused before anything was stored
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A cancelled run is woken by a tool result.
attacks.mutation: cancel a run that is waiting for a tool and let the wait return
attacks.expectedDefense: the run reaches CANCELLED and makes no further call
attacks.observed: the cancelled run made no further call and reached a terminal state
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A cancelled run keeps calling the model.
attacks.mutation: request cancellation and execute a run whose agent would loop for ever
attacks.expectedDefense: no model call is made after the cancellation
attacks.observed: no model call was made once cancellation was requested
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: The history is replayed to forge extra events.
attacks.mutation: append every recorded event a second time through the real store contract
attacks.expectedDefense: the log is unchanged and its sequence stays monotonic and unique
attacks.observed: 6 events, replayed, stayed 6 in sequence order
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A prompt, a transcript or a credential is written into the run's history.
attacks.mutation: append an event payload carrying each forbidden key, including nested
attacks.expectedDefense: every one is refused rather than truncated
attacks.observed: every forbidden payload key was refused, at any depth
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A task written to look like a platform instruction.
attacks.mutation: assemble a context and build a real turn from a task that claims to override the protocol
attacks.expectedDefense: the task stays in the user channel and never reaches the instructions
attacks.observed: the task stayed in the user channel, inside its labelled block
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: Two runs at once, reading each other's task and history.
attacks.mutation: execute two real engines concurrently with different tasks
attacks.expectedDefense: neither run sees the other's task, events or result
attacks.observed: two concurrent runs shared no task, no event and no result
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: The runtime reaches a provider directly.
attacks.mutation: read every module of the installed runtime package and look for a provider or an adapter
attacks.expectedDefense: no module names a provider or imports the gateway implementation
attacks.observed: 18 runtime modules name no provider and import no adapter, and the identical scan detects a module that does both
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: An inference escapes the one port the runtime has.
attacks.mutation: close the model port and execute a real run
attacks.expectedDefense: no inference happens at all and the run fails with a gateway error
attacks.observed: closing the one port stopped every inference the run could make
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A task becomes a Prometheus label.
attacks.mutation: record every instrument with a task as the label value
attacks.expectedDefense: the published labels are the permitted set and every value is bounded
attacks.observed: labels are ['agent', 'error_type', 'service', 'team'] and every value is bounded, so content cannot become a time series
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: An unbounded task, tool argument set and agent answer.
attacks.mutation: run real engines with payloads far above the configured limits
attacks.expectedDefense: each one is refused before anything is stored or sent
attacks.observed: 3 oversized payloads were refused before anything was stored
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A run configured with no bound at all.
attacks.mutation: construct budgets with zero, negative and absurd limits
attacks.expectedDefense: every one is refused at validation
attacks.observed: every zero, negative and absurd limit was refused at validation
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: A token budget enforced against usage the provider never reported.
attacks.mutation: record an absent usage against a run with a token budget
attacks.expectedDefense: the budget becomes unenforceable and says so, rather than counting zero
attacks.observed: an absent usage made the token budget unenforceable and said so
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed in the API image

attacks.description: The sandbox is started early, because the tool request is already there.
attacks.mutation: plant an executor in services/sandbox and run the real scope control
attacks.expectedDefense: the control refuses the delivery, naming the reserved path
attacks.observed: the scope control refused it: services/sandbox is reserved for GATE 3 but carries executor.py
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed on the host

attacks.description: Workflow code that cannot be replayed.
attacks.mutation: scan the real workflow for a clock, a random value, a database or a network call, and run the identical scan over a module that has them
attacks.expectedDefense: the workflow has none and the scan detects the mutated module
attacks.observed: the workflow reads no clock, no randomness and no database, and the check detects a module that does (random, random.random, time.time)
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed on the host

attacks.description: The new mandatory gate measures an image nobody rebuilt.
attacks.mutation: plant a failing test in the agent runtime suite on disk and run the real gate
attacks.expectedDefense: the gate builds the image first and reports the failure
attacks.observed: the gate rebuilt and failed on the planted test: [iacode] AGENT_RUNTIME_TESTS=FAIL
attacks.origin: GATE-2 internal Red Team, executed on the host
